hypothesis.method: Neuroevolutionary optimization of transformer attention patterns via spiking neural network surrogates
hypothesis.problem: Transformer models exhibit opaque attention dynamics that hinder interpretability and adaptability in low-data regimes
hypothesis.goal: Dynamically generate human-readable, context-aware attention maps that evolve with input complexity without retraining
